query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_group_binding b JOIN whatsapp_linked_account a ON a.id=$3 JOIN whatsapp_group_membership m ON m.binding_id=b.id AND m.account_id=a.id WHERE b.id=$1 AND b.user_id=$2 AND b.ownership_state='active' AND b.state='active' AND a.authorization_generation=$4 AND a.state IN ('connected','offline') AND m.authorization_generation=$4 AND m.consent_ended_at IS NULL AND whatsapp_linked_can_view(b.channel_id,a.user_id) AND whatsapp_linked_can_view(b.channel_id,b.user_id)) AS "valid!"
